overview: The Office of Research compiles statewide and county-level profiles on Ohio’s population. Data includes current and forecasted trends, selected population characteristics, and estimates by demographics.
report_note: The Ohio Population Projections Report is derived from demographic trends, including age distribution, fertility, mortality, and migration patterns. Economic, political, and policy factors were not considered or incorporated, though these factors can substantially affect population outcomes. The projections featured in this report are data-informed estimates that illustrate the population shifts that could occur if point-in-time demographic trends persist.
